title: Theft
text: [synthetic] A person who dishonestly takes movable property out of another person's possession without consent commits theft.

title: Cheating
text: [synthetic] A person who deceives another and thereby dishonestly induces that person to hand over property commits cheating.

title: Hurt
text: [synthetic] A person who voluntarily causes bodily pain or injury to another commits the offence of hurt.

title: Criminal intimidation
text: [synthetic] A person who threatens another with injury to person or reputation, intending to cause alarm or to make that person act against their will, commits criminal intimidation.

title: Stalking
text: [synthetic] A man who repeatedly follows a woman or contacts her by electronic communication despite clear disinterest commits stalking.

title: House trespass
text: [synthetic] A person who enters a house without permission, intending to commit an offence or to cause annoyance, commits house trespass.

title: Information in cognizable cases
text: [synthetic] Information about a cognizable offence given to the officer in charge of a police station shall be recorded in writing and signed by the informant. If the officer refuses to record it, the informant may send it to the Superintendent of Police.

title: Rights of an arrested person
text: [synthetic] A person who is arrested shall be told the grounds of arrest and may inform a relative or friend, and shall be produced before a magistrate promptly.

title: Bail in bailable offences
text: [synthetic] A person accused of a bailable offence shall be released on bail on furnishing a bond, with or without a surety.

title: Maintenance of wife, children and parents
text: [synthetic] A person with sufficient means who neglects or refuses to maintain a wife, child or parent unable to maintain themselves may be ordered by a magistrate to pay a monthly allowance.
